children: RNS Number : 0681V  Metlen Energy & Metals PLC  16 September 2026
Notification of Transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (“PDMR”)

Metlen Energy & Metals PLC (the "Company") confirms that, on 11 September 2026, it granted conditional share awards ("Awards") over ordinary shares of €1.00 each in the Company ("Shares") under the Metlen Energy & Metals Omnibus Plan to the following Directors and other Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities ("PDMRs"):
Gavalas Christos - Group Chief Executive Officer
Ioannou Fotini - Group Chief Financial Officer
Chrisafis Evangelos - Executive Vice Chairman of Metlen Εnergy & Metals Single Member S.A.
Benroubi Dinos - Vice Chairman & CEO of METKA ATE
Bouzali Paraskevi - Chief Corporate Affairs & Communication Officer
Giannakopoulos Ioannis - Chief Executive Director Integrated Utility
Kanellopoulos Panayotis - Chief Executive Director International Energy Supply & Trading
Karaindros Elenos - Chief Strategy and M&A Officer
Papadopoulos Dimitrios - Executive BoD Member of Metlen Εnergy & Metals Single Member S.A., Executive Senior Advisor to the Executive Chairman & the Board
Papapetrou Nikolaos - Chief Executive Director Renewables & Energy Transition Platform
Stefanidis Dimitrios - Chief Executive Director, Metallurgy
The Awards will vest subject to satisfaction of performance conditions and continued employment. The performance targets that apply to the awards are as follows:
Relative TSR against constituents of FTSE 100 index (excluding investment trusts) for FY2026 – FY2028

25% of the Award will vest at threshold performance and 100% of the Award will vest at maximum performance. There will be straight line vesting between these points and nil vesting for below threshold performance.
Each Award is also subject to a minimum requirement for satisfactory personal performance by the participant during the three-year performance period.

Following the vesting of Awards, any vested Shares received by the Executive Directors are subject to a holding period which expires on the fifth anniversary of the date of grant, during which time the Shares may not be sold.
This announcement is published in accordance with the disclosure requirements that apply by virtue of the Company's primary listing on the London Stock Exchange.
